wallet.title: Rent Wallet
wallet.intro: Every rupee of rent, working for you — record the home you rent and see your yearly total, your deposit and the tax your rent is saving you.

wallet.hraNote: Pune is a non-metro (40% of basic). Claim it in your ITR — ask your landlord for signed receipts adding up to the yearly total above.
wallet.addSalaryPrompt: Add your annual basic salary to see how much tax your rent is saving you.

wallet.passportSoonSub: A portable record of rent you have paid — coming soon.
